title: 分析化学
subtitle: Analytical Chemistry
teachers:
SUZUKI Yasutada
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
After completing this course, you will be able to :
1. Perform calculations for molar mass and molarity using titration data.
2. Perform calculations involving molar solubility and solubility product constant.
3. Describe complexation titrations using the Lewis concept of acids and bases.
4. Systematically balance oxidation-reduction reactions
advice: Analytical Chemistry is a foundation course for School of Applied Chemistry, also highly related to Laboratory course on sophomore and junior, and also senior capstone-course (Project Design III). The course is designed to help build a foundation of Analytical Chemistry, Acid-Base titration, Chelatometric titration, and Redox Titration. Through the course, the foundations of this titration method will be described from the view of gravimetric analysis. At the end of the course, you can solve single answer problems using these foundations.
books: Hisanori Imura, Teruo Hinoue, "Basics of Analytical Chemistry", Kagaku Dojin
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physics, and math are required.

activityGoals.body: You will be able to describe the foundation of acid-base titrations.

You will be able to explain redox titration.

achievementLevels.ideal:
At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to:
- Perform titration calculations for given reactions.
- Describe factors that affect the gravimetric analysis.
- Solve complex problems using the foundations of titrations.
- Simulate a precipitate formation for given conditions.
achievementLevels.standard:
At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to:
- Perform titration calculations for given reactions.
- List factors that affect gravimetric analysis.
- Solve simple problems using the foundations of titrations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Analytical Chemistry is a foundation course for School of Applied Chemistry, also highly related to Laboratory course on sophomore and junior, and also senior capstone-course (Project Design III). The course is designed to help build a foundation of Analytical Chemistry, Acid-Base titration, Chelatometric titration, and Redox Titration. Through the course, the foundations of this titration method will be described from the view of gravimetric analysis. At the end of the course, you can solve single answer problems using these foundations.

              Hisanori Imura, Teruo Hinoue, "Basics of Analytical Chemistry", Kagaku Dojin
